race.title: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap (Div 2)
race.verdict: KARTINI still looks well treated on the pick of her form and can make it 2 wins from her last 3 starts. Class-dropper Humble Spark is feared most, with Rory's Gold and Regalian others to consider. KARTINI (IRE) HUMBLE SPARK (IRE) RORY'S GOLD (IRE)
